baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic nominal construction joins الفجار at word 2 to لفي جحيم at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The group is defined by departure from right and breached restraint, while جحيم supplies an enclosing field of concentrated heat. The verse therefore couples a moral mode of crossing limits with an environment whose intensity leaves no neutral interior.

activation_trace.role: Departure from right and breach of restraint supplies the ethical definition of the named group.
Blazing fire and severe heat supplies the containing medium asserted by لفي.

changed_reading.before: A generic class of wicked people will have a generic fiery punishment.
changed_reading.after: People constituted by breached restraint are emphatically located inside a concentrated medium that makes their limit-crossing consequential.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of الفجار can be heard materially as rupture and outflow, while the preposition في places that outward-driving identity inside جحيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: A name normally heard as a moral category retains a hydraulic image of splitting and discharge. The construction creates a reversal: those characterized by uncontrolled outward breach are themselves enclosed by an intensifying blaze.

activation_trace.role: Wide splitting and outflow recasts the group name as a disposition that breaks bounds and releases what was held.
The blaze supplies the intense enclosure that reverses the breakers' outward motion.

changed_reading.before: فجار is only an abstract moral label and جحيم only a destination noun.
changed_reading.after: The clause stages a spatial reversal in which habitual breakers and releasers are now the ones contained within an uncontrollable blaze.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Two peripheral focus branches connect الفجار with dawn-disclosure and جحيم with a glowing, staring eye.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can carry an exposure register alongside punishment: a darkness-breaking light meets an unaverted fiery gaze. This does not replace the ethical sense of الفجار, but makes their placement also an event of being made visible.

activation_trace.role: Dawn breaking from night, including the true and false dawn distinction, gives the group name a latent disclosure contrast.
The glowing or staring eye turns the infernal term into an image of harsh, sustained visibility.

changed_reading.before: The sentence concerns heat but not disclosure.
changed_reading.after: The sentence can also picture concealed breach crossing into an illuminated field where the breakers remain exposed to a fiery gaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence breaks the sky, scatters the stars, opens the sea as a wide fissure, and then uses the exact focus root for the seas' bursting. When the same root returns as الفجار, a cosmic event has become an agentive human identity: they are the boundary-breakers of the moral order. Their being في جحيم then reverses the sequence by enclosing the agents of rupture.

activation_trace.role: Wide splitting and outflow is the focus image reactivated by the earlier material sequence.
Intense blaze becomes the terminal enclosure for agents named by rupture.
Opening and splitting initiates the surah's material grammar of failed boundaries.
Casting things in dispersion shows ordered members losing their held arrangement.
The sea's wide-fissure branch makes its following explosion a breached container rather than generic motion.
The exact focus root first appears as the seas being split open and discharged, directly materializing the later human label.

structural_cues: The first four ayat repeat إذا with feminine passive rupture, dispersal, and overturning verbs.
The same root moves from a passive cosmic event in 82:3 to a definite plural human class in 82:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the rupture sequence and exact root recurrence; I infer an event-to-agent transformation and a final reversal from breaking containers to being contained. A live alternative is that the recurrence intensifies sound and imagery without redefining the ordinary moral noun.

changed_reading.before: The wicked are a pre-given ethical class later assigned to fire.
changed_reading.after: The opening apocalypse teaches how to hear their name: they have made cosmic-style boundary rupture into a human disposition, and the breakers are now enclosed by the blaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: What was buried is turned up; the self comes to know; vigilant guardians preserve; writers enter names into a register; and knowledge of deeds is explicit. Against that chain, إن ... لفي reads not only as a forecast but as a disclosed classification whose evidentiary basis has been uncovered and retained.

activation_trace.role: Breach of right supplies the conduct by which the registered class is identified.
The blaze is the emphatically assigned position produced by the evidentiary chain.
Turning soil and exposing what was buried starts the movement from concealment to inspectable evidence.
A thing becoming disclosed to its knower makes the self itself a witness to the recovered record.
Guarding and preserving prevents the evidence of breach from being lost.
Entering a name into a register or class makes the focus plural an adjudicated category rather than a loose insult.
Knowledge as disclosure closes the chain by attaching the preserved record to actual deeds.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from opened graves to self-knowledge and then to guardians, writers, and known actions.
The focus clause uses doubled assertion, إن and ل, rather than a future verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncovering, preservation, registration, and knowledge; I infer that the focus assertion functions like a presently legible verdict. The alternative is a simpler future promise whose nominal certainty does not imply an already constituted record-position.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely predicts where an ethically obvious group will go.
changed_reading.after: The verse pronounces a record-backed placement: concealed acts have become legible, the name has become a registered class, and its fiery position is asserted as settled.

context_deltas.mechanism: One self gathers what it advanced and what it deferred into a single moment of knowledge. That temporal compression activates the focus branch in which many calamities arrive suddenly: الفجار can be read as people whose dispersed acts and delayed effects finally discharge together into the concentrated heat named by جحيم.

activation_trace.role: The sudden bursting-in of many supplies the image of accumulated consequences arriving together.
The intense blaze gives the gathered consequences a single experiential medium.
The self as the very identity of the thing supplies one bearer for acts spread across time.
Advancing and going ahead supplies the forward-carried portion of the self's effects.
Deferral to a later time supplies effects held back until the moment of disclosure.

structural_cues: The coordinated pair ما قدمت وأخرت compresses a temporally dispersed life into one object of knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one self, acts sent ahead, acts delayed, and a focus branch of many things arriving suddenly; I infer accumulation followed by discharge. The alternative is that 82:5 merely inventories all deeds without implying a reservoir or burst mechanism.

changed_reading.before: فجور is a stable trait punished by a separately prepared fire.
changed_reading.after: Fujur is also a temporal accumulation: advanced and deferred breaches converge on their bearer, and their massed return is experienced as an already concentrated blaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human is deceived by what gleams without holding, in relation to a generous Lord, and then denies account and recompense. This activates the true-versus-false dawn carried by the focus root: the fujjar mistake the temporary brightness of deferred generosity for the true light of acquittal, until the blaze supplies a terminal and destructive illumination.

activation_trace.role: The true and false dawn distinction supplies the model of misread moral light.
Departure from right keeps the optical model anchored in the group's actual ethical breach.
Blazing intensity becomes the harsh light that ends the mistaken reading of delay.
Deception by something that shines but does not endure supplies the false brightness.
Noble generosity supplies the real good whose delay is misread as exemption.
Contradiction of truth names the cognitive act by which the deceptive reading is maintained.
Account and recompense identifies the denied horizon that would distinguish patience from acquittal.

structural_cues: The rebuking question about deception is followed by كلا بل, which relocates the problem in denial of judgment.
The focus noun follows that diagnosis rather than introducing an unrelated class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive shine, generosity, denial of account, and true-versus-false dawn; I infer that deferred generosity is mistaken for acquittal. A live alternative is that غرّك indicts self-deception without making generosity itself the apparent light.

changed_reading.before: The fujjar knowingly choose darkness and are later put in fire.
changed_reading.after: They are also misreaders of light and delay: they convert generosity into a false dawn of immunity, and the blaze exposes the error in that temporal reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human is measured into being, made straight and complete, set upright, and composed part into part. The focus branch defines fujur as departure from right and breached restraint. The moral label thus becomes a counter-creation: not a defect in the given form, but an agent's active disintegration of a prior measured integrity.

activation_trace.role: Departure and breached restraint supplies the motion away from an originally ordered form.
The intense blaze supplies the environment in which chosen dis-integration becomes fully consequential.
Completed creation and balanced form establishes integrity as the human starting condition.
Straightness and intrinsic completion supplies the axis from which fujur departs.
Setting a thing upright and balanced supplies the equilibrium later violated.
Composing one thing into another makes human form an integrated assembly rather than an accidental heap.

structural_cues: Three coordinated creation verbs address the same singular human before the next ayah specifies composed form.
The adversative كلا بل later makes denial a response that contradicts this bestowed order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured formation, straightness, balance, composition, and ethical departure; I infer that repeated breach deforms the agent's received integrity. The alternative is a purely juridical contrast in which bodily formation and moral liability remain separate domains.

changed_reading.before: Fujur is misconduct added externally to an otherwise irrelevant created body.
changed_reading.after: The fujjar are those who turn a measured, balanced, composed gift against its own integrity; the focus verdict names self-produced deformation before it names destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: دين supplies both account/recompense and financial debt; writing establishes an obligating judgment; and final ownership or disposal is removed. The focus placement can therefore be heard as an already accrued, nontransferable liability whose settled experiential form is جحيم, not merely as movement to a remote location.

activation_trace.role: Breach of restraint supplies the action by which liability accrues.
The blaze supplies the concrete condition in which the settled account is experienced.
Account and recompense supplies the dominant adjudicative frame denied by the addressees.
Financial debt supplies the exploratory image of an obligation that survives delay and demands settlement.
Writing as proof that establishes a ruling makes the account binding rather than mnemonic only.
The repeated account branch fixes a day on which the recorded liability becomes encounter.
Ownership and power of disposal, explicitly negated in context, blocks transfer or self-managed settlement.

structural_cues: دين recurs at 82:9, 82:15, 82:17, and 82:18, surrounding the paired destination clauses.
The final ayah negates one self's capacity for another before assigning all command to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies account, debt, binding inscription, repetition, and loss of disposal; I infer a liability model in which the fiery placement is already accrued and cannot be transferred. The financial branch may be only an analogy, while account and recompense remain the stronger mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The fire is an externally selected penalty announced after denial.
changed_reading.after: The emphatic في marks a settled account-position: breached obligations remain attached to their agents, cannot be traded away, and become lived as blaze on the day of settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding clause has the same emphatic frame: a definite human plural is لفي an indefinite condition noun. Truth that carries through word and deed inhabits softness and ease; breached restraint inhabits blaze. The exact mirror makes نعيم and جحيم matched media that disclose their inhabitants' organizing dispositions.

activation_trace.role: Departure from right supplies one pole of the paired moral topology.
Blazing intensity supplies the medium corresponding to breached restraint.
Truth that carries through speech and action supplies the integrated counter-class.
Softness, ease, and comfortable life supplies the counter-medium to severe heat.

structural_cues: 82:13 and 82:14 repeat إن plus a definite plural plus لفي plus an indefinite state noun.
Only the class root and containing condition change, producing a formally balanced antithesis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact syntactic mirroring and branch-level contrasts of integrated truth versus breach and softness versus blaze; I infer correspondence between disposition and habitat. The alternative is rhetorical antithesis that guarantees opposite outcomes without implying that each environment expresses its inhabitants' character.

changed_reading.before: 82:14 is an isolated threat following an unrelated promise.
changed_reading.after: It is the second half of a matched topology: integrated fidelity is inside ease, while breached integrity is inside blaze, so each medium reveals the disposition it contains.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, the human is made straight and set upright; the focus names departure from that line. The verb after the focus both directly denotes meeting fire and carries a branch in which fire straightens or levels what is exposed to it. This revises the blaze from static penalty into a terrible operation that removes the latitude of self-chosen deviation.

activation_trace.role: Departure from right supplies the bent trajectory on which the operation acts.
Severe heat supplies the operative medium rather than a merely labeled location.
Straightness and completion establishes the original line from which fujur departs.
Uprighting and balancing supplies the prior equilibrium recalled by forced leveling.
Meeting fire and its heat grounds the immediate verb in actual thermal encounter.
Kindling heat and straightening a thing by fire supplies the exploratory operational image.

structural_cues: The active plural verb in 82:15 immediately resumes the feminine referent جحيم from the nominal placement in 82:14.
The earlier creation triad supplies straightness and balance before the later heat encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior straightening, later deviation, direct fire-contact, and a fire-straightening branch; I infer punitive re-leveling, not healing or restoration. The live alternative is that the context verb activates only contact with fire and carries no corrective direction.

changed_reading.before: Jahim is a passive container holding those who deviated.
changed_reading.after: Jahim can also be an irreversible heat-operation that ends the freedom to remain bent, a forced leveling that must not be softened into rehabilitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guardians are vigilant, deeds are disclosed to knowledge, and the inhabitants cannot be absent or hidden from the fire. These cues sharply activate the focus branch of جحيم as a glowing, staring eye. The infernal medium becomes an unblinking field of exposure as well as heat.

activation_trace.role: Breach of restraint supplies what the exposed agents can no longer conceal.
The glowing or staring eye supplies the focus image of an infernal medium that never averts its gaze.
Vigilance and little heedlessness supplies the unbroken attention that activates the staring image.
Disclosure to a knower makes the gaze evidentiary rather than decorative.
Concealment from eyes, explicitly negated by the verse, removes absence as an escape from the field.

structural_cues: The negated agent noun in 82:16 states continuing nonabsence rather than a single entry event.
Observation language precedes the paired destination clauses and returns as impossibility of concealment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vigilance, disclosed action, nonconcealment, and the focus eye branch; I infer a personified unblinking field. The alternative keeps observer and punishment separate: angels watch, while fire only contains continuously.

changed_reading.before: The fujjar encounter painful heat but visibility is incidental.
changed_reading.after: Their placement is also total exposure: the blaze functions like a glowing eye, and neither deeds nor agents can exit its field by becoming absent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The doubled question about what can make one know the Day carries a split mapping: one target supplies abundant outflow from a source, while the other supplies knowing itself. Repetition lets cognition and eruption coexist. The focus verdict can then be read as a compressed disclosure whose full meaning bursts open only in the severe event of account.

activation_trace.role: Wide splitting and outflow supplies the focus-side pattern echoed by knowledge arriving as discharge.
The intense blaze supplies the event whose reality exceeds the compact prior proposition.
Abundant outflow from a source supplies the dominant mapped image of disclosure as a sudden discharge.
Knowledge and practical apprehension supplies the non-dominant mapped target that directly fits the question.
A day's severe event supplies the bounded occurrence in which the compressed statement opens into experience.
Account and recompense identifies what the repeated question says cannot be exhausted by prior description.

structural_cues: 82:17 and 82:18 repeat the same question, with ثم marking renewed escalation rather than supplying an immediate definition.
The short focus assertion precedes two questions that destabilize any sense that its content has been cognitively exhausted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a genuine split mapping with outflow and knowledge targets plus doubled interrogation; I infer that apprehension arrives eruptively and echoically reactivates فجر. The live alternative is that only the non-dominant د ر ي knowledge target is semantically active and the dominant د ر ر outflow is a formal mapping artifact.

changed_reading.before: The focus clause is a complete informational statement whose terms are already mastered.
changed_reading.after: It is a compressed certainty but not an exhausted concept: the Day forces its meaning to burst into apprehension, turning stated blaze into overwhelming encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: A peripheral focus branch remembers collective battle-days named for violated sanctity, and a جحيم branch intensifies battle and death. The final ayah then repeats نفس while denying one self any disposal for another and locating authority elsewhere. The plural الفجار can thus be heard as a coalition of mutually reinforced breach whose protective network collapses at the fiery verdict.

activation_trace.role: The battle-days named for violated sanctity supplies a historically collective form of transgression.
Battle or death at full blaze supplies the collective violence that turns back upon the coalition.
Each self as its own identity supplies the irreducible units left when group protection is stripped away.
Power of ownership and disposal, negated between selves, removes reciprocal control or rescue.
Authority and its possessor supplies the exclusive command that replaces the group's failed social power.

structural_cues: The focus uses a plural class, while 82:19 repeats singular نفس on both sides of a negated relation.
The final clause transfers الأمر away from every human network.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a violated-sanctity battle branch, battle-blaze, self-to-self incapacity, and exclusive authority; I infer a transgressive coalition whose mutual protection collapses. The alternative is that the historical battle branch contributes only remote etymological color and the final verse addresses individuals without social-network implications.

changed_reading.before: الفجار is merely a numerical plural of unrelated bad individuals.
changed_reading.after: It can also name a social formation built through shared violation; in جحيم that formation cannot distribute risk or rescue its members, and each self remains separately exposed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses peripheral terrain and weather branches rather than the ordinary ethical senses. It remains anchored in the exact adjacent syntactic mirror and in both focus roots. Downstream prose should present it only as an image-level antiphony, never translate الأبرار as land, الفجار as water, or نعيم as wind.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus rupture/outflow branch and blaze branch occupy the second half of an exact pair with 82:13.

activation_trace.role: Wide splitting and outflow supplies an unstable hydraulic image for the focus class.
Severe heat supplies the harsh climate surrounding that uncontrolled outflow.
Dry land and open desert supplies the stable counter-ground in the paired clause.
A soft wind supplies the gentle counter-climate to the focus blaze.

changed_reading.before: The paired verses contrast only abstract moral labels and afterlife nouns.
changed_reading.after: At the level of latent material imagery, stable open ground under a soft wind is opposed to uncontrolled fissure and outflow enclosed by severe heat.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the racing sense of ص ل ي is form-distant from the direct fire verb, although both mapped inventories are packet-backed. It remains anchored in the focus plural, its sudden-many branch, and the immediately following plural verb. Downstream prose should call it a procession or imitation resonance, not claim that يصلونها lexically means following a racer here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural الفجار is placed in a battle-intense blaze and immediately resumed by the plural verb يصلونها.

activation_trace.role: The sudden arrival of many supplies a cohort rather than an isolated offender.
Battle or death at a blaze supplies the collective terminal field.
The runner who follows the predecessor supplies a latent sequence of one agent tracking another.
The non-dominant mapped branch independently preserves following the leader in a race, strengthening the procession image.

changed_reading.before: Each wicked person independently arrives at the same fire.
changed_reading.after: The plural may carry a social procession: breaches become precedents, followers reproduce them, and the cohort tracks itself into the same conflagration.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates two peripheral ج ح م senses and internalizes an ordinarily external place. It remains wholly anchored in the two focus words and gives their branches a coherent affective sequence. Downstream prose should render it as an embodied resonance alongside literal blaze, not replace جحيم with psychology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins a restraint-breaching class to a term whose inventory includes little shame and a face flaring with anger.

activation_trace.role: Breach of restraint supplies the initiating loss of moral inhibition.
Little shame supplies an inward echo of the group's restraint-breaking identity.
A face flaring with anger supplies the bodily heat through which inward disorder becomes visible.

changed_reading.before: The verse places morally bad agents in a wholly external furnace.
changed_reading.after: A secondary affective anatomy appears: repeated breach erodes shame, heat rises inwardly, and the flaring exterior displays the disorder that the literal blaze finally surrounds.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because overflowing generosity is a remote branch of the same root that names the wicked. It remains anchored by الفجار and is activated by the repeated كرم language around Lord and writers. Downstream prose should describe a contrast between disciplined and counterfeit overflow, not assign generosity as the lexical meaning of الفجار.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A peripheral ف ج ر branch of abundant giving sits inside the focus noun while generosity is explicitly attributed elsewhere in the context.

activation_trace.role: Overflowing generosity supplies an excess-image that can be ethically redirected or counterfeited.
Breach of restraint keeps the outflow model tied to misdirected excess rather than actual virtue.
The blaze supplies the endpoint of excess that has lost measure and right direction.
Noble, praiseworthy generosity supplies the first disciplined countermodel of abundance.
The same noble generosity attached to the writers repeats abundance under order and accountability.

changed_reading.before: The fujjar oppose generosity simply because they are morally bad.
changed_reading.after: They may embody counterfeit overflow: energy, spending, or self-release that imitates abundance but breaches measure, unlike the ordered generosity named around them.

strongest_changes: The exact ف ج ر recurrence turns the seas' passive bursting into the later human agent-name, so the breakers are finally enclosed by blaze.
The creation sequence recasts fujur as active deformation of a measured, straight, balanced, and composed human integrity.
Uncovering, guardianship, writing, and knowledge make the emphatic nominal clause read as a record-backed present classification, not only a remote forecast.
The exact 82:13-14 mirror makes نعيم and جحيم matched habitats that disclose the opposed dispositions they contain.
Later fire-contact, nonabsence, repeated knowing questions, and loss of inter-self control preserve operational, perceptual, epistemic, and social readings alongside the legal one.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made one short binary clause unusually productive: an exact same-root echo from ruptured seas, a syntactic twin immediately before it, and later split-root inventories allowed material rupture, false dawn, forced leveling, unblinking exposure, eruptive knowing, and failed coalition to coexist without displacing the ordinary breach-and-blaze reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The nominal emphatics guarantee certainty, but whether لفي describes a present moral state, an assured future placement, or both remains open.
The causal correspondence between breached integrity and fiery habitat is reader-supplied; the packet also permits a purely juridical assignment.
False-dawn, debt, fire-straightening, staring-eye, terrain, racing, and generosity activations are branch-backed but increasingly analogical and require explicit qualification.
For the split د ر ي mapping, knowledge is semantically direct while abundant outflow may be only a formally licensed echo.
